name: Web Development
description: Learn to build modern, responsive websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. Covers front-end and back-end fundamentals with hands-on projects.

name: Java Programming
description: A comprehensive course covering Java fundamentals, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, and multithreading.

name: Python
description: Introduction to Python programming including syntax, data structures, functions, file handling, and an overview of popular libraries.

name: Data Structures
description: Study of core data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs, along with algorithmic complexity analysis.

name: Operating Systems
description: Covers OS concepts including process management, memory management, file systems, scheduling algorithms, and concurrency.

name: Computer Networks
description: Introduces networking fundamentals including OSI/TCP-IP models, routing, switching, and network security basics.

name: Database Management
description: Covers relational database design, SQL, normalization, transactions, and indexing with hands-on lab exercises.

name: Machine Learning
description: Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, and model evaluation using Python.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Explores search algorithms, knowledge representation, reasoning, planning, and an introduction to neural networks.

name: Cyber Security
description: Introduces network security, cryptography basics, ethical hacking concepts, vulnerability assessment, and security best practices.

name: DevOps
description: Covers CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, orchestration basics, and version control workflows using Git and Jenkins.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Introduces cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), virtualization, and hands-on exposure to major cloud platforms.

name: Software Engineering
description: Covers the software development lifecycle, requirement analysis, design patterns, testing strategies, and agile methodologies.

name: Mobile App Development
description: Hands-on course on building cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, covering UI components, navigation, and state management.

name: UI/UX Design
description: Introduces design thinking, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and modern UI design principles using Figma.

name: Cryptography Fundamentals
description: Covers classical and modern cryptographic techniques, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures.
